authorization: User requested autonomous continuation and choice of solutions after initial fitting blocker
stopping: advance only after fitting failure; freeze the first fitting-eligible configuration for timing selection; any final-validation failure blocks continuation
score: per-track signed Sampson residual in pixels, remove one constant median residual, then RMS after Huber loss at 1 pixel; median across tracks
bias_interpretation: Nuisance correspondence bias only; does not alter accepted camera parameters. Constant-velocity tracks may be unidentifiable and must fail the optimum-gap/uncertainty gates.
support_policy: one fixed reference interval per track, valid for every lag in [-25,25]; no changing observations to improve an offset score
roma_seed_policy: both endpoints in hash-bound dynamic masks; combine three target-time hypotheses before confidence-ranked source-cell deduplication, independent of timing score
roma_pixel_centers: to_pixel_coordinates returns half-integer continuous centers; subtract 0.5 for OpenCV integer centers
reserved_protocol: After fitting passes, freeze parameters, graph and correspondence policy; selection and final get fresh dynamic tracks from their own windows, lag search within +/-1 frame of frozen lag, half-window estimates and reference graph agreement <=0.25 frame; final has a distinct one-use marker. Neither reserved role may change static calibration.
failure_policy: Retain all fits, source/config hashes and resource records; no threshold relaxation, camera removal, training or reserved timing access after a fitting failure. Both failed stages constitute the next evidenced blocker.
